issue_title: Capture exact customer delivery baseline decision

approach.summary: Create one decision record that names the exact delivery SHA, version, retained package artifact(s), and superseded candidate baselines before any additional handoff work proceeds.
rationale: The upstream analysis shows the retained release evidence is bound to `4d63e03 / 9.0.8`, while the current workspace on 2026-04-18 is dirty and cannot be shipped without an explicit baseline choice.
Every remaining delivery artifact depends on the chosen build identity; without one baseline record, smoke evidence and handoff notes become non-traceable.
This keeps the first step bounded and decision-focused instead of mixing stakeholder confirmation with evidence regeneration.
non_goals: Do not refresh release evidence in this issue.
Do not assemble the customer handoff bundle in this issue.
risk_controls: Use the retained release evidence files as the reference source for the currently validated baseline.
Record both the selected baseline and the rejected candidate state so later artifacts can explain why one path was chosen.

tasks.description: Compare the currently validated `4d63e03 / 9.0.8` evidence-bound baseline with any newer candidate SHA the operator may want to ship, and list the package filenames and evidence files currently attached to each candidate.
